q: Where is the cheapest moment to fix a misunderstanding with a coding agent?
options: At the plan stage, before code is written
explain: Plans are cheap to change; implementations are not.

q: When fixing a bug with an agent, what should come first?
options: A failing test that reproduces the bug
explain: A failing test gives the agent feedback and proves the fix.

q: Vibe coding is most acceptable for…
explain: Review depth should scale with what the code can break.
